run_hydra_app_with_logging: run a Hydra app that logs info and debug level messages using Python logging
create_hydra_app_with_logger: create a Hydra app that uses logging.getLogger to log info and debug messages
run_my_app: run the my_app function decorated with hydra.main to log info and debug messages
review_hydra_logging_setup: review the Hydra app my_app and its logging setup with info and debug level messages
refactor_my_app_logging: refactor the my_app function to add additional log levels beyond info and debug
